idea: Use OR-Tools CP-SAT, if importable, with optional 2D intervals (AddNoOverlap2D) on an integer L×L board. Each candidate square has a size variable chosen from a domain, presence literals are constrained to sum to n, and the objective is the total of the sides. Iterate L over 6..16 with time slices and fall back to the closed-form constructions if the library is absent.
